labels.lesson.title: Keep the Discussion Moving When It Gets Stuck
labels.section.title: Rehearse a Small Repair
labels.repair.resources: Locate a gap · ask · leave room
labels.prompt.exact: A community centre wants a 20-minute welcome activity for new members. Help them meet one another and find out about its weekly drawing group. Your group should recommend one activity and explain how it serves both aims. Use the main room and existing paper and pens; do not buy anything.
labels.task.group: Find out about the weekly drawing group
labels.baseline.quote: We could start in pairs and exchange names and interests.
labels.baseline.gap: Link to weekly drawing group not yet explained
labels.planning.prompt: One line about the missing drawing-group link
labels.planning.scope: Explore; do not finalise the activity
labels.rehearsal.prompt: Offer one next move in English
labels.rehearsal.private: Private practice · no recording or scoring
labels.mode.practice: Practice: model, retry, skip or continue
labels.review.question: Give the group something manageable to examine
labels.revision.options: Clarify the aim · reduce demands · remove assumptions
labels.recap: Offer a next step; leave room to respond
labels.model.label: One possible next move
labels.model.question: How would they find out about the weekly group?
labels.model.analysis: Pick up the idea; locate the missing aim
labels.model.limit: A question is not yet an answer
